root_cause: Earlier OpenArt prompts locked Mira facial landmarks, all face pixels, blinking and human movement; the production media gate simultaneously required visible real uninterrupted human motion >=0.900. The generator was instructed to produce an almost static photo with background motion, so no prompt could reliably satisfy both constraints.
prevention_rule: Original source-locked Mira producer must NEVER request literal frozen facial pixels, no blink, no breathing or background-only motion. A deterministic final-prompt validator rejects contradictory prompts before provider spend and creates a source-locked compatible alternative specifying unchanged recognizable original Mira face with restrained physically plausible human blink/breathing/hand action and one continuous take. Original master, daily winner, native MP4, historical rejection dedupe, exact face>=0.940 and temporal>=0.900, one-shot Meta readback remain unchanged.
fix: Implement pure checkMiraProducerPromptCompatibility and buildMiraSourceLockedMotionBrief in existing preventive agent function and expose compatible brief in existing authenticated preflight; wire original Instagram skill and exact CI.
outcome: Candidate design/code only before protected GitHub merge and Supabase production verification; a prompt strategy improvement alone is not a proven new Reel.
